calendar_assumption: All listed weekdays are fictional comparable service dates, including holidays; no real Cornell or Ithaca calendar is inferred.

edge_fixtures.case: exact and near stock thresholds; empty/full

geography: Twelve anchors in Cornell core and eight surrounding anchors; official Cornell venue coordinates and TCAT GTFS20260922 transit coordinates. Geographic visual review and docking-site feasibility are separate; no existing bikeshare facilities are claimed.
limitations: No missing readings, sensor failures, closures or unusable bikes/docks in any scenario.
Inventory persists across service dates; same-hour sequences may have serial dependence, drift or boundary concentration and require independent suitability review.
No operator dispatch, nightly rebalancing, overnight trips or weekend trips are simulated.
Normal means regular simulation, not guaranteed absence of inventory warnings or statistical signals.
Disruption is an operational redistribution, not equipment failure; detection must be evaluated independently.
No SPC implementation or baseline suitability approval is supplied by this generator.

model.afternoon_at_15_16_17: 6 + uniform integer 0..4 attempts each hour, academic to residential
model.background_attempts: 10 at 08/09/10/17/18/19; 6 at other hours after 07; symmetric distance-weighted station pairs
model.capacity_handling: Transfers require a bike at the source and a free position at the destination
model.cross_date_continuity: Each station's next planned date 07:00 inventory equals its previous planned date 21:00 inventory, including Friday-to-Monday
model.disruption_monitoring_morning_at_08_09_1: 48 + uniform integer 0..6 synthetic transfer attempts each hour, residential to academic
model.distance_pair_weight: 1 / (1 + straight-line distance in km), at most 1; not road distance, slope or travel time
model.edge_adjustments: Artificial software fixtures during daytime hours only, not operator dispatch or a claimed natural commuting process
model.evening_at_18_19_20_21: 9 + uniform integer 0..4 attempts each hour, academic/mixed/transport to residential, including library return
model.initial_allocation: 15 bikes at every station only at 07:00 on the first service date; no daily reset or operator redistribution
model.midday_at_11_12_13_14: 6 + uniform integer 0..4 attempts each hour among academic/mixed/transport stations
model.normal_morning_at_08_09_10: 16 + uniform integer 0..6 synthetic transfer attempts each hour, residential to academic
model.outside_observation_window: No movements are modeled outside 07:00-21:00 or on unlisted weekend days; inventory is held unchanged
model.sensors: All automatic readings accurate, complete and on the scheduled hour
model.transfer: Instantaneous single-bike movement, no in-transit inventory or travel times

provenance: Inventories, bikeshare stations and flows are entirely simulated; geographic landmark anchors are real official-source coordinates. No real sensor readings, demand observations or trip records.
